name: Estimation
instructions: These are estimation problems. Your answer must be a single number written in digits, with no units and no range.

questions.prompt: Roughly how many times does a human heart beat over an 80-year life?
Roughly how many full turns does one tire of an ordinary passenger car make while driving 100 kilometers?
Roughly how many sheets of ordinary office printer paper would you need to stack to make a pile 1 meter tall?
Roughly how many liters of water does it take to fill an Olympic-size swimming pool?
Roughly how many words are in a typical 300-page printed novel?
A high school has 1,000 students. Roughly how many pencils do all of its students use up, in total, during one school year?
